quests.title: The Last Seed-Bank

find.text: An old seed-jar in the yam shed holds nothing but a label in a careful Imperial hand: 'Third of three. The other two lie with Raven Rock's ledger and the grove that grows in spirals.'

quests.desc: An empty seed-jar at a farm in the ash names two other pieces of a map. One is in Raven Rock, the other in a spiral grove.
quests.pitch: The yam farmer at Old Attius Farm keeps a jar that is labelled 'third of three'.

objectives.text: Recover the cornerstone's second map-piece in Raven Rock.
Follow the spiral bearing of Brodir Grove north through the Frostmoth ruins.
Open the sealed crates in Fort Frostmoth's cellar and take the greenhouse key.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The map's three parts point to a sealed cellar in the Nordic temple under the mountain.

quests.title: The Last Seed-Bank (II)
quests.desc: The map's three parts point to a sealed cellar in the Nordic temple under the mountain.
quests.pitch: The yam farmer at Old Attius Farm keeps a jar that is labelled 'third of three'.

objectives.text: Take the surveyor's key from the Ashfallow wizard.
Ask the Tel Mithryn master for his workbook and the route to the old temple.
Open the cellar of the lowest nave and face the warden of the green.

quests.outro: The cellar was cold and dry, its shelves lined with sealed jars, each labelled in a careful hand. I carried one out. In a year, the island may not need to eat ash.

quests.title: Six Stones, Five Songs

find.text: A hunter's cloak is spread across the lodge porch with a bone flute tucked in its folds. A scratch on the rail: 'Five answer. One does not. I have gone to ask it why.'

quests.desc: A hunter's flute and a note at the lodge door say five of the island's stones answer and one does not.
quests.pitch: A Skaal hunter's door hangs open and the larder is untouched.

objectives.text: Play the flute at the Hvitkald cairn and head for the stalhrim basin.
Harmonise the flute with the stalhrim and find the water stone in the west.
Play the flute at the water stone and bring its note back to the Skaal circle.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The five stones' songs lead to the Skaal's circle and a sealed barrow where the sixth waits.

quests.title: Six Stones, Five Songs (II)
quests.desc: The five stones' songs lead to the Skaal's circle and a sealed barrow where the sixth waits.
quests.pitch: A Skaal hunter's door hangs open and the larder is untouched.

objectives.text: Confront the Skaal elder and learn the sixth verse's first line.
Take the rubbing of the defaced post to the barrow by the east shore.
Sing the sixth verse before the barrow mural and free the hunter.

quests.outro: In the barrow, the mural sang its missing verse through my flute and the sixth stone woke, far away, with a sound like a kettle boiling over. The Skaal elder will have to be told, and will not thank me.

quests.title: The Frozen Engine

find.text: A stove-lid in the trader's shed is stamped with a ship's-wheel and the words 'Chart Four of Four'. A lever behind it opens a drawer of oiled bone charts.

quests.desc: A trader's stove-lid carries a stamp and a drawer of bone charts, the last of four sets that belonged to a lost ship.
quests.pitch: The Orc at the trading post buys anything, but the stove-lid he will not sell.

objectives.text: Take Chart Three from the reavers' table and find the wreck on the north shore.
Pry open the wreck's bow-chest for Chart Two.
Hear the skald's wrong verse and take Chart One from behind the trophy shield.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The charts lead through two Dwemer ruins and end at the giant's castle of ice.

quests.title: The Frozen Engine (II)
quests.desc: The charts lead through two Dwemer ruins and end at the giant's castle of ice.
quests.pitch: The Orc at the trading post buys anything, but the stove-lid he will not sell.

objectives.text: Align the four charts under the Kagrumez dome.
Find the valve in Nchardak's flooded hall and take it to Karstaag's castle.
Stand before Karstaag's throne and decide what the island's winter will be.

quests.outro: The throne of ice hummed under my hand, a cold-engine the giant had mistaken for a seat. I took the vane and left the rest. Better the island stays cold than learn what it is to be warm.
